content:
❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: Some specifications missing from the statement.
Inadequate case coverage.

Goal
* Please change "based on their log level:" to "whose log level is <<equal to or more important>> than a given [[loglvl]]. The log levels, from most important to least important, are:".

* Please add the following immediately below the list of log levels:

Each log line is in this format:

{{<}}[[application]]{{>}} [[log level name]]{{optional space:}} [[message]]

* Please rewrite the following part for accuracy and grammar fix:

the log level may be written with difference capitalization or just include the first 3 letters

Since using "or" suggests that the choice of capitalization and the number of letters are mutually exclusive, which isn't the case, please change the part to:

the [[log level name]] may be written in either all uppercase or all lowercase, and either in full or using only its first three letters

* Please change "result" to "output".

* The final paragraph is no longer needed. Please remove it.

Input
* Please rewrite as follows:

<<Line 1:>> An integer [[loglvl]], representing the log level used to determine which log lines to output.
<<Line 2:>> An integer [[n]] for the number of log lines.
<<Next [[n]] lines:>> A string [[line]], representing a log line.

Output
* Please rewrite as follows:
<<1 or more lines:>> A string [[line]], representing a log line, with the letter case modified where necessary.

Constraints
* Please remove the existing constraint.

* Please add constraints specifying the lower and upper bounds of [[loglvl]] and [[n]].

* Please add: 1 ≤ length of [[line]] ≤ 100.

* Please add that the input always contains at least one log line that satisfies the condition for output.

Stub generator
* Please change "lvl" to "logLvl".

* Please change 128 to 100.

Tags
* Please remove the non-standard "filtering" tag. You could use "Conditions" instead.

Cases
* The [[loglvl]] used in the existing cases is either 2 or 4. Please add three new pairs of cases, one pair for each of the remaining possible values: 0, 1 and 3.

* Across the new cases, please include the following log level names with exactly these letter cases:

  • Not covered by the existing tests: fat, err, war, inf, deb, FAT, ERROR

  • Not covered by the existing validators: fat, FAT, ERROR

By the way, please also fix the same typo in the clash version: change "keywork" to "keyword".

Thanks.
Re published it with minor corrections.
I hope you received enough feedback from the community to improve your contribution. Once you have made the necessary updates, publish your contribution!
Nice contribution, i like the idea :)
Looks like a decent question, there is a little typo in "keywork", in which you probably meant "keyword".

Nice one!

A little suggestion: maybe it would be interesting to make the output format more systematic w.r.t. the colon (:) that separates the log level from the message text. In some examples there is a space between the log level and the ":", in others, there is not.

I propose requiring the output to have the log level be immediately followed by the colon (i.e. without spaces).

Constraints section:
* Please correct "keywork" to "keyword".

Thanks.

For the record, a clash on the same theme written by the same author has been approved before:
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/33016cbd4089319b8d64cba12d67fe7e00ff7

This puzzle looks a bit more difficult than the clash version, so I guess it may be fine.
Yes, tried to adapt it to be sightly more difficult in terms of parsing.
